title: Past Simple (was/were) - Only 'be' verb in past

options.answer: He was at the park yesterday.

explanation.en: For singular subjects like 'he' and 'she', we use 'was' in the past simple. For plural subjects like 'they' and 'we', we use 'were'.
explanation.ru: Для единственного числа ('he', 'she') используется 'was' в прошедшем времени. Для множественного числа ('they', 'we') используется 'were'.
explanation.uz: Birlikdagi otlar ('he', 'she') uchun o'tgan zamonda 'was' ishlatiladi. Ko'plikdagi otlar ('they', 'we') uchun esa 'were' ishlatiladi.

options.answer: The students was in the classroom.
The cat were on the roof.
The children were tired after the game.

explanation.en: The subject 'the children' is plural, so we must use 'were'. 'Was' is used for singular subjects.
explanation.ru: Подлежащее 'the children' (дети) стоит во множественном числе, поэтому нужно использовать 'were'. 'Was' используется для единственного числа.
explanation.uz: The children' (bolalar) ot so'zi ko'plikda, shuning uchun 'were' ishlatishimiz kerak. 'Was' birlikdagi otlar uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: Was you at the party last night?
Were you at the party last night?

explanation.en: In questions with 'you', we use 'were'. 'Was' is used with 'he', 'she', 'it' and singular nouns.
explanation.ru: В вопросах с 'you' используется 'were'. 'Was' используется с 'he', 'she', 'it' и существительными в единственном числе.
explanation.uz: 'You' bilan savollarda 'were' ishlatiladi. 'Was' 'he', 'she', 'it' va birlikdagi otlar bilan ishlatiladi.

options.answer: I wasn't happy with the result.

explanation.en: The correct negative form for 'I' is 'wasn't'. 'Weren't' is the negative form for plural subjects like 'they' and 'we'.
explanation.ru: Правильная отрицательная форма для 'I' — 'wasn't'. 'Weren't' — отрицательная форма для подлежащих во множественном числе, таких как 'they' и 'we'.
explanation.uz: 'I' uchun to'g'ri inkor shakli 'wasn't' hisoblanadi. 'Weren't' 'they' va 'we' kabi ko'plikdagi otlar uchun inkor shaklidir.

options.answer: Were John and Mary at home?

explanation.ru: Подлежащее 'John and Mary' (Джон и Мэри) — это множественное число, поэтому правильный глагол — 'were'. 'Was' используется только для единственного числа.
explanation.uz: 'John and Mary' ot so'zi ko'plikda, shuning uchun to'g'ri fe'l 'were' hisoblanadi. 'Was' faqat birlikdagi otlar uchun ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: Last summer, my family and I ___1___ on a long vacation. The weather ___2___ hot and sunny every day. My sister and I ___3___ excited to explore new places. The hotel we stayed in ___4___ big and very comfortable. Our rooms ___5___ on the third floor. I remember one day, my parents ___6___ a little worried because we ___7___ late for a tour. But in the end, everything ___8___ fine. Our tour guide ___9___ a very kind person. He ___10___ knowledgeable about the history of the city. We ___11___ happy to have him. It ___12___ a great trip and we ___13___ sad to leave. We ___14___ sure that we wanted to come back again soon. The whole family ___15___ happy with the vacation.

explanation.en: Use 'was' for singular subjects (the weather, the hotel, everything, our tour guide, he, it, the whole family) and 'were' for plural subjects (my family and I, my sister and I, our rooms, my parents, we, they, you).
explanation.ru: Используйте 'was' для подлежащих в единственном числе (the weather, the hotel, everything, our tour guide, he, it, the whole family) и 'were' для подлежащих во множественном числе (my family and I, my sister and I, our rooms, my parents, we, they, you).
explanation.uz: Birlikdagi otlar (the weather, the hotel, everything, our tour guide, he, it, the whole family) uchun 'was' va ko'plikdagi otlar (my family and I, my sister and I, our rooms, my parents, we, they, you) uchun 'were' ishlatiladi.
